{{Top|leg}}
The '''Six Gods''', also known as the '''Old Gods''' or the '''god kin''', were the original pantheon of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]]. [[Izax]], the Ultimate Devourer, was the chief [[Deity/Legends|deity]] of the pantheon, while the other members were his wife, [[Scyva]], and their four children: [[Tyth]], [[Aivela]], [[Esne]], and [[Nahut]]. The demon serpent [[Zildrog]] was another entity worshiped by the [[Old Ways (Zakuul)|Old Ways]], though Zildrog was often considered simply an aspect of Izax. [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] claimed to be the [[Demon Savior]] of prophecy, one who would topple the Old Gods and usher in a new era of prosperity, and worship of the Old Gods was mostly abandoned by his [[Eternal Empire]].

==History==
[[File:Izax_the_Ultimate_Devourer.jpg|thumb|250px|thumb|The true form of Izax, the Ultimate Devourer]]
The Old Gods were created by [[Iokath]]'s original architects as titanic [[Droid/Legends|droid]] superweapons to be used on unready civilizations to pacify, subjugate, and destroy them, which led to the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of trillions aeons before the [[War on Iokath]]. Among the victims affected by these superweapons was Zakuul, which caused the superweapons to be mythologized as ruthless deities. The superweapons slumbered after the disaster that wiped out the [[Unidentified Iokath species]], but the Old Gods were eventually awakened.<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|The Six Gods}}</ref> This occurred during the [[Machine Gods crisis]] on Iokath in [[3629 BBY]]. The [[Heralds of Zildrog]] still followed the old ways but were considered more of a cult.
